units.container_s_per_video_s: seconds of one container of the kind's pool per second of episode video, amortized over `concurrency` episodes in flight per container
units.startup_s: seconds from container start to ready (@modal.enter), paid once per container
units.uncertainty: relative half-width of the error bar (0.35 = +/-35%)

note: Seeded from P0/W3 measurements on a handful of episodes; S2 (golden build) replaces them. `status`: measured | projected | placeholder.

rates.provenance: W3-A run 1 sequential: 4 WS-D episodes (1080p HomER, 153.6 video s) in 1,322 s on H200 = 0.116 video-h per container-h (docs/exact-concurrency.md)
W3-A run 1 concurrency 4: same 4 episodes in 626 s = 0.245 video-h per container-h, straggler-bound (docs/exact-concurrency.md)
W3-A steady-state projection: 1.9 GPU-s per video-s at ~90% lock occupancy +16% contention = ~0.40 video-h per container-h; needs a >=8-episode batch to confirm (docs/exact-concurrency.md)
W3-A run 2 sequential: 2x ALOHA 3-view (640x480, 44.0 video s) in 175 s = 0.252 video-h per container-h; low resolution, 2 episodes (docs/exact-concurrency.md)
W3-A run 2 concurrency 2: 105 s = 0.418 video-h per container-h (docs/exact-concurrency.md)
WS-H batched terminal: 3 episodes (76.9 video s) in 2.25-2.96 s of llm.generate = 0.03-0.04; padded ~3x for decode/collage, which was not timed separately (docs/rewarder-smoke.md)
WS-H batched dense: 9 clips of 3 episodes (76.9 video s) in 8.62 s of llm.generate = 0.11; padded ~3x for decode/collage, not timed separately (docs/rewarder-smoke.md)
